description: Google Docs surgical authoring and workflow engine

commands.description: Read and edit Google Docs with batched steps: query, write, edit, remove, style, table, tab, doc, share, page.
commands.notes:
• Read the gdocsmith skill before the first run in a session.
• Every step is checked and applied to an in-memory copy first; nothing is sent unless all steps and guards pass. dryRun: true returns the same result without sending. Sending happens in phases; a failure names the phases that landed.
• Target content with anchors: {section} (heading text or ID), {node} (node/cell ID from query), {text} (unique substring), {body: true} (whole tab). Change the smallest scope that covers the edit.
• `doc` is a raw doc ID (between /d/ and /edit) or an alias set by a doc step's `as` earlier in the same run.
• Content is markdown only. query output "markdown" is an editable copy: keep its frontmatter and tokens when writing it back.
• Large results are saved to files; the response gives the paths and an outline.
• Refusals list what a step would break (comments, suggestions, named ranges, heading links, chips, images). Use force: true on that step only with the user's consent.
• Never compute character offsets or call the Docs API directly.

dryRun.description: Check and plan every step; send nothing; same result.

steps.description: Steps, applied in order to an in-memory copy before sending.

action.description: delete is permanent; trash is recoverable.

as.description: Alias for later steps in this run (open/create/copy).

doc.description: Doc ID or alias (all actions but create).

StepDoc.description: Open, create, copy, rename, trash, or delete a doc.

at.description: Limit to this node, section, or tab body.

expectCount.description: Fail unless exactly this many matches.

force.description: Proceed despite the breakage a refusal listed.

tab.description: Tab ID or title (default: all tabs).

StepEdit.description: Find and replace plain text; replaces every match in scope.

node.description: Node or cell ID from query.

section.description: Heading text or ID: the heading and everything under it.

text.description: Unique substring of one node's plain text.

Anchor.description: Where a step acts. Set exactly one key.

tab.description: Tab ID or title (default: all tabs).

StepPage.description: Page setup for every tab, or one tab.

at.description: Limit to a node, section, or text match.

saveTo.description: Absolute directory to always save the result into.

tab.description: Tab ID or title (default: all tabs).

StepQuery.description: Read a doc; large results are saved to files.

fragile.description: Only chips, images, equations, footnotes, rules, TOC.

NodeFilter.description: Node filters for output "nodes"; all set filters must match.

force.description: Proceed despite the breakage a refusal listed.

StepRemove.description: Delete a node, a section (heading + subtree), or a tab body.

StepShare.description: Add, list, or remove Drive sharing.

force.description: Proceed despite the breakage a refusal listed.

where.description: Only restyle runs whose set values match these.

StepStyle.description: Set text/paragraph style; null resets a property.

ParagraphStylePatch.description: Paragraph properties; null resets to the inherited value.

BulletPreset.description: Docs API `createParagraphBullets` glyph presets (v2's own copy: v2 code never imports `src/core/dom/**`, see the G3 import boundary). `src/core/model/lists.ts` (G3 M2) re-exports this type alongside the runtime preset table.

NamedStyle.description: Docs named paragraph styles, including TITLE and SUBTITLE.

TextStylePatch.description: Run properties; null resets to the inherited value.

TextStyleMatch.description: Run filter; every set property must equal the run's set value.

after.description: Place after this tab (ID or title).

before.description: Place before this tab (ID or title).

force.description: Proceed despite the breakage a refusal listed.

from.description: Seed the new tab with a copy of this content (create).

tab.description: Tab to rename, move, or delete (ID or title).

StepTab.description: Create, rename, move, or delete a tab.

bodyOnly.description: With section: copy only what is under the heading.

doc.description: Source doc ID or alias (default: this step's doc).

CopySource.description: Content to copy; omit node and section to copy the whole tab.

at.description: Table/cell ID ({node}) or {section} holding one table.

force.description: Proceed despite the breakage a refusal listed.

StepTable.description: Change table structure or cell style.

pinnedHeaderRows.description: Header rows repeated per page (table only).

after.description: Insert after (a section: after its last node).

append.description: Append to the end of the tab.

before.description: Insert before (a section: before its heading).

force.description: Proceed despite the breakage a refusal listed.

markdownFile.description: Absolute path of a markdown file (e.g. an edited export).

replace.description: Replace, diffed: unchanged nodes keep their IDs.

StepWrite.description: Write markdown or copied content. One content field, one placement.

diff.description: Unified diff across all modified tabs.

dryRun.description: True when dry-run previewed without writing.

file.description: Saved diff path when too large.

RunDiff.description: Structured unified diff returned in run result.

alias.description: Document alias if bound during run.

RunDoc.description: Document touched or created in a run.

requests.description: Total requests planned in this phase.

sent.description: True if requests were sent and landed.

created.description: Newly created blocks, tabs, or documents.

files.description: Paths of written or spilled files.

outline.description: Outline returned alongside markdown queries or saveTo.

commands.description: Print the program version.
Set up MCP config for this app (binary via Homebrew).
commands.notes:
Set up agent artifacts after the binary is installed via Homebrew (see README for tap install).

Homebrew installs the binary and shell completions only. Agent artifacts live under ~/.agents and are not written during brew install.

After install or upgrade:
  gdocsmith configure install

Upgrade:
  brew upgrade gdocsmith
  gdocsmith configure install

Shell completions are installed by Homebrew during brew install.
See: https://docs.brew.sh/Shell-Completion

See what is installed:
  gdocsmith configure status

Uninstall:
  gdocsmith configure uninstall
  brew uninstall <tap>/gdocsmith

Use `configure status --json` for machine-readable output.
